newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French PIBOR interest rate futures surged on Wednesday on renewed market hopes of interest rate cuts, giving a lift at the same time to 10-year bond futures, which were limited by caution ahead of U.S. data on Thursday.
March PIBOR fnished just shy of a contract high at 96.76 with PIBOR gaining further out as well, although economists said there was little fresh reason for the buoyancy.
Gains in the March 10-year future came in its wake but were limited by extreme caution, principally ahead of U.S. producer price data due at 1330 GMT on Thursday.

The U.S. data will dominate, traders said, but the markets will also have several other events to contend with, including German unemployment data and the Bundesbank's monetary policy council where no rate cut is expected.
All of 10 economists polled by Reuters on Wednesday said they did not expect an interest rate cut.
German unemployment data are due at 0900 GMT on Thursday and economists are also forecasting a rise in December of between 35,000 and 60,000, after a record 4.1 million in November.

U.S. wholesale price data are due to be released at 1330 GMT and analysts surveyed by Reuters are looking for a 0.3 percent gain in the overall Producer Price Index and a 0.1 percent rise in the core index excluding volatile food and energy prices.
They are keeping an eye on rising energy prices for any sign of inflationary pressures further out.

For Friday, economists polled recently forecast, on average, U.S. December payrolls growth of 192,000, an unemployment rate of 5.30 percent and a 0.2 percent rise in hourly earnings in data to be released at 1330 GMT.
